upgrade.name: Denim
upgrade.summary: Base Mainnet activation has not been scheduled. Denim is in planning, and the upgrades index treats a month without a confirmed timestamp as a target that may change.
upgrade.order_summary: No upgrade order between op-geth and op-node is stated for Base.
upgrade.warning: Base lists Mainnet as planning for November 2026 and Sepolia as planning for October 2026. Those months are not activation times. Denim does not name an op-geth or op-node release. The operator node is published from base/base as ghcr.io/base/node.
